verdict.rationale: SumUp has a well-documented public REST API with SDKs, sandbox/testing tools, API-key auth, and even AI-native tooling like an official MCP server and Agent Toolkit for LangChain/OpenAI Agents/MCP, plus llms.txt for machine-readable docs. Community evidence confirms real developers building on the public API directly, though no formal OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths.
